gripOrHq.title: Inside Job
gripOrHq.rulesText: Make a run. You automatically pass the first piece of ice you encounter during that run.

heapOrArchives.title: All-Nighter
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

heapOrArchives.title: MIT West Tier
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Shuffle your hand, trash, and stack together, and then draw five cards. When you play MIT West Tier, remove it from the game instead of trashing it.

scoreArea.title: Artificial Security Directors
scoreArea.rulesText: Difficulty of Black Ops agendas is reduced by 1.
